row.evidence: Viva Glint access requires users to "exist in both Microsoft Entra ID and Viva Glint", with a Glint admin importing users by SFTP, web upload or Microsoft 365 Organizational data; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Glint is now sold as Microsoft Viva Glint, inside Microsoft Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback ($6.00 user/month, paid yearly) and Viva Suite ($12.00). Sign-in is through the customer's Microsoft Entra tenant (other IdPs only by federating with Entra), so sso_plan is the cheapest Glint-bearing plan. No SCIM: employee records come from an SFTP HRIS feed, People page uploads or Microsoft 365 Organizational data; a Status attribute (ACTIVE/INACTIVE) in the file handles leavers. No user API documented. The Okta OIN 'Glint Innovation' app is an unrelated product (SWA).

plans.name: Microsoft Viva Workplace Analytics and Employee Feedback

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Viva Glint documentation (full table of contents checked). Users are loaded by SFTP file feed, People page web upload, or Microsoft 365 Organizational data import; sign-in is through Microsoft Entra ID. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: No user-management or audit-log API appears in the Viva Glint documentation.

okta.notes: Search 'glint' finds only 'Glint Innovation', an unrelated ideation product (SWA).

entra.notes: Entra gallery has a legacy 'Glint Inc' SAML SSO app (no provisioning tutorial). Viva Glint itself is registered in the customer's Entra tenant; users still have to be imported into Glint separately.

fallbacks.other_sync: SFTP HRIS file feed; Microsoft 365 Organizational data import
